# [TASK] Audit Story #83 and Tasks #2-#5 (project scaffolding, Gradle build, GitHub templates, Docker Compose)

## Task
Take story #83 and its tasks (#2 to #5) through the four gates in
`/audit-artifacts`: Shape, Voice, Truth, Proof.

Subject area: project scaffolding, Gradle build, GitHub templates, Docker Compose.

Findings already recorded from the review of #1 to #5:

- #2 names `frontend/filmpire`. ADR-013 renamed it to `frontend/lmdb`.
- #3, #4 and #5 each close on a dated criterion ("verified 2025-11-14") with

- #5 states ".env.example documents all configurable variables". That is not
  checkable, and the file is at `infrastructure/docker/.env.example`.
- #2 to #5 carry a `sprint-0` label while their milestone is Sprint 1.
- Story #83 has one criterion covering four tasks, and its Notes are a run

## Acceptance Criteria

      writing standard, hold at most 5 criteria, and carry no empty section
